latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Automates daily Git commit reports and code review for image-tool and voc projects.

- Sends daily Git commit summaries for all remote branches of image-tool, and dev branch for voc-frontend/voc-backend.
- Performs automated code review, covering security checks (like hardcoded credentials, SQL injection) and general code quality.
- Delivers formatted reports via DingTalk, listing commits, file changes, review results, and improvement suggestions.
- Supports user commands to schedule, query, or cancel daily report delivery.
- Provides detailed report templates and setup instructions, including cron scheduling and tool dependencies.
